author: @mel
text:
Last Week Recap:

Last week has been a relatively calm week. My traing plan got triggered
on thursday. So I had to wait 4 days for price to come to my prefered
level. The trade was triggered by a limit order while I was away.

So I had one trade, 1 winner. Weekly target reached.

What did I learn last week?

Something I already knew, last week was just another confirmation of it

-Patience is key

-Planning will give me a clear and realistic idea of what and where I would like to trade.

-Remain an eternal student of the market! The more I grow as a trader,
the more I realise that there will always be something to learn about
and I'm really excited about that.

Mel

author: @mel
text:
EDIT: Had issues uploading the right charts Re-posting now...

Trading map for this week

Point A & D are my prefered areas as they both have a very strong
drop/rally from their base, so structure wise they are stronger.
However, I can't deny the fact that price did broke all this supply (see
 charts), so I found 2 decision points on M1, I marked them in a dashed
pink line, also tagged as point B & C.

Point E is also a demand area, would look there if price breaks point D.

And finally the black lines are also decision point above the supply at 1 and under the demand at point D.

Again, I will only look to trade at one of this points. As price has now
 bounced from a supply area, it is trading south in a compressed
fashion, I'll look at the dashed pink line to see if I can trade the
levels.

As always, I'll watch how price approaches all of the levels.

Mel
